name: Vinales Town Center (Calle Salvador Cisneros)
tagline: Rocking-chair porches and the main street buzz
description: The compact heart of Vinales strung along Calle Salvador Cisneros, lined with pastel casas particulares, paladares, bars and the main square. Everything is walkable, wifi hotspots and shops are nearest here, and casa hosts sit on porches watching the day pass. The most convenient base for most visitors.
bestFor: First-time visitors, walkers, easy access to food and casas
pros: Closest to wifi hotspots and transport
cons: Busiest and most touristy part of town

name: Valley Farms toward Mural de la Prehistoria and Los Jazmines
tagline: Tobacco fields, mogotes and the postcard viewpoint
description: The valley proper southwest of town, where tobacco farms with thatched drying barns spread beneath towering mogotes, the giant Mural de la Prehistoria is painted on a cliff, and the Los Jazmines viewpoint delivers the classic panorama. Farm-stay casas and finca restaurants sit among the fields.
bestFor: Nature lovers, horseback riders, photographers, slow travel
pros: Authentic farm life and finca dining
cons: Farther from town shops and wifi
Need a bike, horse or taxi to get around

name: Cueva del Indio and Palmarito area
tagline: Caves, river boats and quieter countryside
description: North of town along the road toward the Cueva del Indio, where you can walk and take a boat through a lit cave, and the rural Palmarito zone known for horseback trails, farms and cave visits. A greener, quieter pocket that feels well outside the main tourist strip.
bestFor: Cave visits, horseback tours, travelers wanting seclusion
pros: Access to Cueva del Indio and horse trails
cons: Reliant on transport for meals and errands

name: Road toward Puerto Esperanza and Cayo Jutias
tagline: Gateway to the coast and the beaches
description: The northwestern route out of the valley toward the sleepy fishing village of Puerto Esperanza and, farther along, the white-sand beaches of Cayo Jutias. A staging area for coastal day trips, with scattered casas and a slower, off-the-beaten-path feel away from Vinales' center.
bestFor: Beach day trips, coast lovers, travelers seeking quiet
pros: Easy launch point for Cayo Jutias and the coast
cons: Far from town amenities and wifi
